Class DatabaseController

java.lang.Object
DatabaseController
public class DatabaseController extends Object
Creates and handles the JDBC connection, uses SQL database operations against MySQL NarrativeContainerDB database.

Handles login information to get into the database access via JDBC strings supplied by the user supplied credentials, establishes connection, executes SQL operations made to query, sort, insert, and delete Characters
